Issue: Superquadric/asphere integration scheme 4 can dereference ksl_rotation before checking CFD implicit coupling pointer
Impact: Crash or undefined behavior for exposed integration_scheme 4 without implicit CFD data
Recommended fix: Guard scheme 4 at input/init time; require couple/cfd/force/implicit or disable scheme; add regression test

Issue: Granular shear/contact history requires newton pair off
Impact: Duplicated pair work and larger ghost communication limit strong scaling
Recommended fix: Design symmetric history ownership with deterministic reduction and migration; validate against old newton off path

Issue: Contact-history lookup during neighbor build is linear in npartner for each candidate pair
Impact: Dense/cohesive systems pay O(candidate pairs * contact degree) metadata cost
Recommended fix: Use sorted per-atom partner lists or hash/CSR tag-to-history index rebuilt once per reneighbor

Issue: No dynamic load balancing in public build; processor grid is static/uniform
Impact: Hoppers, piles, insertion streams, and segregation cases become imbalanced across MPI ranks
Recommended fix: Add weighted spatial split rebalancer using particle/contact cost and safe migration

Issue: Communication uses posted receives plus blocking sends and global collectives in hot paths
Impact: Limited overlap and synchronization bottlenecks at scale
Recommended fix: Introduce nonblocking exchange phases, delayed waits, neighbor-distance collective throttling, and profiling counters

Issue: Particle arrays are pointer-based double** component arrays instead of flat SoA/AoSoA
Impact: Cache/TLB overhead and weak SIMD/GPU portability
Recommended fix: Add experimental flat SoA backend behind AtomVec adapter; migrate hot pair/integrate kernels first

Issue: CMake is legacy and dependency discovery is fragile
Impact: Hard-to-reproduce builds and weak CI/container integration
Recommended fix: Modernize CMake targets/options/presets; remove automatic downloads from default path

Issue: No CI/regression/performance test harness found in source snapshot
Impact: Performance regressions and physics regressions can pass unnoticed
Recommended fix: Add smoke, restart, deterministic, and benchmark tests; publish baseline logs

Issue: Restart and dump I/O are root-centric or file-per-rank; no scalable self-describing parallel format
Impact: Large simulations produce bottlenecked or hard-to-manage output
Recommended fix: Add HDF5/ADIOS2/XDMF backend with chunked particle/contact/mesh datasets

Issue: CFD MPI coupling allocates external arrays by tag_max
Impact: Sparse or large tags can inflate memory dramatically
Recommended fix: Switch to compact local maps with tag-index indirection and sparse exchange

Issue: PairGran scans insert/stream/predefined fixes every compute call
Impact: Avoidable overhead in tight force loop setup
Recommended fix: Cache relevant fixes and invalidate on modify list changes

Issue: Documentation has stale/inconsistent feature claims for superquadric public availability
Recommended fix: Regenerate docs from active styles and mark optional dependencies accurately
